name: 張庭
objective:
本課程以社會科學與心理學為基礎，探討人際溝通在不同社會情境中的運作方式，協助學生理解訊息如何被建構、傳遞與詮釋，以及人際互動如何受到個人、文化與科技因素的影響。課程內容涵蓋人際溝通理論、訊息傳播、自我形象管理、知覺與他人理解、身份認同、家庭與友誼、愛情與親密關係，以及職場、醫療與風險情境中的溝通實務。此外，課程亦關注科技發展對人際關係與溝通型態的影響，包括科技中介溝通、網路社群互動與數位平台中的人際關係。透過理論與實例分析，學生將學習辨識不同溝通情境中的互動模式與挑戰。

本課程旨在培養學生的人際溝通能力與批判思考能力，並提升其在日常生活與專業情境中進行有效溝通的能力。教學方式採學生中心取向，結合講授、引導式提問、小組討論與案例分析，鼓勵學生主動參與，並將溝通知識實際應用於多元社會情境中。

This course is grounded in the social sciences and psychology and examines how interpersonal communication operates across diverse social contexts. It aims to help students understand how messages are constructed, transmitted, and interpreted, and how interpersonal interactions are shaped by individual, cultural, and technological factors. Course topics include theories of interpersonal communication, message transmission, self-presentation and image management, perception and understanding of others, identity formation, family and friendship, romantic and intimate relationships, as well as communication in workplace, healthcare, and risk-related contexts. The course also addresses the impact of technology on interpersonal relationships and communication patterns, with particular attention to technology-mediated communication, online communities, and digital social interaction. Through theoretical discussion and case-based analysis, students will learn to identify communication dynamics and challenges in both face-to-face and mediated environments.

The objectives of this course are to develop students’ interpersonal communication skills, empathy, and critical thinking, and to enhance their ability to communicate effectively in everyday life and professional settings. A learner-centered approach is adopted, incorporating lectures, guided inquiry, small-group discussions, and case analysis to encourage active participation and the practical application of communication concepts in real-world social situations.
